newsitem.title: UK: Shield signs exploratory research agreement.
newsitem.headline: Shield signs exploratory research agreement.

text.p: Shield Diagnostics Group said on Thursday it has an exploratory research agreement with the diagnostics division of Abbott Laboratories Inc.
It said the agreement allows access to Abbott instruments, reagents and training for the purposes of technically assessing their capabilities to develop new assays.
Shield Diagnostics is a health care organisation specialising in the development and manufacture of in vitro medical diagnostic devices.
It said additional financial terms will be negotiated during the term of the preliminary agreement.
